About the Company

At RENPHO, we are driven by the mission to make wellness accessible to everyone. From smart scales and massagers to fitness devices, our innovative products bridge the gap between technology and personal well-being. With a global presence and over 20 millions of customers, we are dedicated to delivering products that enhance lives, promote healthier habits, and improve overall well-being.
Founded in 2016, we grew to become a market leader on Amazon with its smart consumer electronics products. With offices in Los Angeles, Europe, Hong Kong, Korea, Taiwan and Tokyo. We are currently looking to expand our team.

Job Summary

We are seeking a creative and community-focused App Community Growth Specialist to build, manage, and grow our app community. This role will be responsible for creating an engaging user environment, increasing community participation, encouraging referral activities, and developing strategies to improve user engagement and retention.

The ideal candidate understands mobile app communities, user behavior, digital engagement, and creative community-building strategies. This person will help transform our app community from a user platform into an active and connected ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

App Community Management & Growth

Manage and grow the app-based user community by creating an engaging and interactive experience.
Develop community strategies to increase user participation, engagement, and retention.
Monitor community activities, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
Build programs that encourage users to return, participate, and share the app with others.

User Engagement & Community Activities

Create engaging content, discussions, challenges, campaigns, and interactive activities within the app community.
Develop creative initiatives to make the community experience more fun, valuable, and memorable.
Encourage user-generated content and meaningful conversations among community members.
Recognize and nurture active users and community advocates.

Referral Program Engagement

Develop creative campaigns to increase referral participation and user acquisition.
Identify opportunities to motivate users to invite friends and expand the community.
Analyze referral activities and provide recommendations to improve conversion and engagement.
Collaborate with marketing teams on referral campaigns and promotions.

Community Feedback & User Insights

Serve as the voice of the app community by collecting and analyzing user feedback.
Identify user needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve the app experience.
Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Support teams to communicate community insights.

Community Performance Tracking

Track and analyze key community metrics, including:
Active community users
User engagement rate
Referral participation
Campaign performance
User retention
Prepare reports and recommendations to improve community growth.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Growth, and Customer Experience teams.
Support app launches, feature releases, and user engagement initiatives.
Assist in developing strategies to strengthen the overall app ecosystem.

Qualifications

* 5+ years of experience in community management, app operations, social media, digital
marketing, or user engagement.
* Experience managing online communities or mobile app communities preferred.
* Strong understanding of user engagement strategies and community-building practices.
* Creative mindset with the ability to develop campaigns and interactive experiences.
* Strong communication skills and ability to connect with users.
* Data-driven approach with the ability to analyze engagement performance.
* Experience with referral programs, consumer apps, or digital platforms is a plus.

About the Company

About the Role
Renpho is seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the execution and optimization of customer communication across email and SMS.
This role will ensure consistent, timely, and relevant messaging throughout the customer journey, from initial engagement through post-purchase and reactivation. Working closely with the DTC team, this role will support key business initiatives by improving how and when we communicate with our customers.

Key Responsibilities
Build and manage automated lifecycle flows (welcome, post-purchase, win-back, etc.), ensuring consistent communication across key customer stages
Execute weekly email and SMS campaigns aligned with DTC priorities, including promotions, product launches, and seasonal moments
Develop and apply customer segmentation to improve targeting, personalization, and overall relevance of messaging
Maintain CRM platform operations, including campaign setup, data quality, and deliverability standards
Track performance across campaigns and flows, providing insights to support ongoing optimization and testing
Partner with DTC, Creative, and Web teams to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent execution across all customer touchpoints

Qualifications
3–5+ years in email marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing within DTC
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar platforms
Experience building and managing automated lifecycle flows
Strong execution skills with attention to detail and follow-through
Basic understanding of segmentation, testing, and campaign performance
Clear written communication skills for North American audiences

What Success Looks Like
Consistent execution of campaigns and lifecycle flows across key business moments
Improved structure and coverage of lifecycle communication across the customer journey
Strong CRM platform organization, data quality, and deliverability
Clear visibility into performance to support DTC decision-making

About the role

RENPHO is seeking a bilingual Sales Operations Specialist to provide centralized operational support for our sales business across the Americas, including the United States and South America.
Based at our Eastvale warehouse location, this person will connect the Americas sales team with colleagues in China and our warehouse, customer service, finance, and supply chain teams. The role keeps customer requirements, product information, orders, inventory status, and delivery timelines accurate and actionable.
We are looking for someone who understands how physical products move from available inventory through order processing, warehouse fulfillment, and customer delivery. You will learn RENPHO's internal systems, clarify requirements in English and Mandarin Chinese, and turn them into clear next steps for the sales team and internal partners.

Responsibilities:

China and Americas coordination

Serve as a central operational contact for the Americas sales team and colleagues in China.
Use English and Mandarin Chinese to clarify customer requirements, internal processes, order status, and outstanding decisions.
Learn company systems and workflows; help salespeople understand required inputs, approval steps, timelines, and dependencies.
Turn requests and meetings into clear actions, owners, and deadlines, following up through completion.
Raise unresolved issues with a concise explanation of the customer impact and the decision needed.

Orders, inventory, and fulfillment coordination

Maintain visibility into customer purchase orders, processing status, inventory availability, warehouse readiness, and delivery commitments.
Work with warehouse and supply chain teams to confirm stock availability, inbound timing, order release requirements, and expected fulfillment dates before commitments are made to customers.
Understand customer receiving requirements, shipping windows, delivery appointments, and documentation needs; coordinate with the teams responsible for execution.
Track backorders, inventory discrepancies, delayed receipts, shipment exceptions, and proof of delivery, keeping salespeople informed of changes affecting customers.
Coordinate product samples and support resolution of returns, shortages, and other order issues.

Customer and account operations

Support national and regional retailers, distributors, marketplace partners, and other B2B customers across the Americas.
Coordinate customer onboarding, account documentation, product setup, and routine customer requests.
Maintain accurate customer, product, approved pricing, and order records in company systems.
Gather product specifications, UPCs/GTINs, case packs, dimensions, and other information needed for account setup and fulfillment.
Support finance with invoice discrepancies, deductions, and payment questions by gathering records and coordinating follow-up.
Maintain current price lists and product availability information; assist with routine quotations and customer materials using approved inputs.

Reporting and process improvement

Prepare regular reports on sales, open orders, inventory constraints, upcoming commitments, and unresolved issues.
Reconcile information across sales and operational systems and investigate discrepancies with the appropriate owners.
Maintain practical procedures and trackers that improve handoffs between sales, China teams, and warehouses.
Identify recurring delays or missing information and recommend improvements.

Qualifications:

Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese, including speaking, reading, and writing for day-to-day business coordination.
3-5 years of experience in sales operations, order management, customer operations, or sales support within a business selling physical products.
Working understanding of purchase orders, inventory availability, warehouse fulfillment, and customer delivery timelines.
Experience coordinating with warehouses, supply chain teams, or distribution operations.
Strong Excel skills and experience working with ERP, order management, CRM, or inventory systems.
Ability to learn internal processes and explain them clearly to salespeople and other stakeholders.
Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through across multiple accounts and deadlines.
Practical judgment about what can be resolved independently and what requires approval or escalation.
Ability to work on site and participate in scheduled coordination with China-based colleagues across time zones.

Preferred experience

Supporting retailers, distributors, or ecommerce marketplace accounts.
Consumer electronics, wellness products, manufacturing, import/distribution, or other physical consumer goods.
Working with China-based headquarters or operations teams.
Customer receiving requirements, EDI orders, retailer portals, or warehouse management systems.
Supporting sales or customer operations in Latin America.
Bachelor's degree in business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What success looks like

Salespeople have reliable information on inventory, orders, and delivery timelines.
Customer and internal requests have clear owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
China and Americas teams understand the same requirements and next steps.
Order and fulfillment risks are surfaced early, with a plan for resolution.
Account records and operational reports are accurate and current.
Sales leadership spends less time chasing updates and resolving routine operational issues.
